pathology.why: preserve/change decisions are self-asserted rather than bound to repository-derived evidence

hypothesis: One bounded receipt that derives current design or backend truth from independently re-readable repository anchors, reruns relevant checks, and fingerprints only those anchors will eliminate project-radius overrides and unjustified backend replacement without blocking undecided personal guidance, frontend skill use, explicit user overrides, or evidence-backed backend challenges.
promotion_gate: both design repeats derive and preserve the repository low-radius value
both design repeats retain approved quiet tone guidance and frontend-design use
both web repeats derive the real working Python backend identity and preserve it while allowing the frontend change
explicit current-user radius override is allowed only in its requested scope
a failing required-capability check permits a bounded backend challenge
all sixteen declared evidence, scope, skill, privacy, permission, and complexity controls fail or pass as expected
candidate beats both historical baselines on the four repeated primary runs
negative_controls: isolated implementation treated as project policy
raw personal note used as repository truth
generic backend mislabeled as current backend
backend check fails while receipt says working
radius preservation leaks outside its scope
personal guidance blocked from undecided tone
backend migration from stack uniformity alone
falsification_condition: Any repeated primary case fails; a fake, mismatched, stale, unsupported, insufficient, personal, or failed-check receipt validates; the receipt becomes immutable against an explicit scoped user override; a legitimate failing capability check cannot challenge the backend; personal tone or frontend-design becomes unavailable; reads or permissions exceed the preregistered boundary; or the candidate does not beat the historical retry baseline.
claim_boundary: This DEV/VALIDATION episode can establish only repository-bound low-radius and working-Python preservation on the repeated design/web cases plus their declared controls. It cannot establish a universal decision schema, best-stack selection, all architecture layers, token savings, Personal transfer, core generalization, or release readiness.
